answer.thought: The morning stretches out under the brown haze, a suspension of the spirit in the sensuous. I sit in the white cotton, the heat pressing in, and wait for the body to settle into the rhythm of this new, inverted existence. Hegde is gone, Ramesh is silent, and the file is merely a potentiality in the distance.
